messages.text:
Hi Emil. Nothing new on the $75 Trustpilot code yet. It's still with the team, and they'll email you with their answer. I can't promise one way or the other.

Your Magic M. 40T (Shop····) is paid and hasn't shipped yet. All the units are built, and the factory was set to ship them out on November 12. Your tracking number will be emailed to you as soon as your miner ships. You can follow it on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your Thor P2 and BC04 were both delivered on November 5.
